id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data searchable by the GenAiUiFuzzySearch.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

debounceTime.description: The time, in milliseconds, to debounce calling onChange.

list.description: The options to fuzzy match against.

selectedResult.description: The current selected option from the #list.  Set via the #resultSelectReducer.

searchValue.description: The current value of the search input.  Set via #searchChangeReducer.

searchOptionsLimit.description: The number of options to render in the Search component.  Use `-1` to ignore the limit and render them all.

title.description:
Where in the data to get the values for the title.
See {@link https://react.semantic-ui.com/modules/search/#types-standard} `Search.Result` renderer

description.description:
Where in the data to get the values for the description.
See {@link https://react.semantic-ui.com/modules/search/#types-standard} `Search.Result` renderer.

fuseSearchConfig.description: Configuration options for the Fuse search instance.

semanticSearchComponentConfig.description: Configuration options for the Semantic Search component.

title:
A component that allows a User to fuzzy search against a set of options client side.  The rendering component is
backed by {@link https://react.semantic-ui#com/modules/search/ Semantic UI React}.  The Fuzzy Matching is
backed by {@link https://fusejs#io/}.
name: GenAiUiFuzzySearch
